riddleDoor.question: I have cities but no houses, mountains but no trees, water but no fish. What am I?

nodes.label: Dungeon Entrance
nodes.description: Cold air breathes from the stone archway ahead. Torchlight flickers across ancient carvings — warnings, perhaps, or invitations. A narrow corridor splits in two: left leads toward distant clashing sounds, right toward an eerie green glow. A wooden chest sits half-open near the entrance.

choices.label: Go left toward the clashing sounds
Go right toward the green glow

nodes.label: Dungeon Entrance
nodes.description: You pry open the chest. Inside: a Health Potion and a crumpled Dungeon Map. The map shows several chambers — one marked with a skull and the word 'HOARD'.

choices.label: Go left toward the clashing sounds
Go right toward the green glow

nodes.label: Goblin Corridor
nodes.description: The corridor opens into a dank passage strewn with bones. Three goblins argue loudly over a pile of loot — they haven't noticed you. A door at the far end is bolted with a heavy iron lock.

choices.label: Sneak past them toward the locked door

nodes.label: Goblin Corridor
nodes.description: You inch past the squabbling goblins — your foot catches a bone. It skitters. The goblins freeze... then go back to arguing. You reach the locked door, but it won't budge without a key.

choices.label: Defeat the goblins to find a key
Head back and try the other path

nodes.label: Goblin Corridor
nodes.description: With a war cry, you leap into battle!

nodes.label: Goblin Corridor
nodes.description: The goblins lie defeated. Rummaging through their scraps you find a battered Iron Sword leaning against the wall.

choices.label: Press deeper — find the Goblin Chief

nodes.label: Chief's Chamber
nodes.description: Beyond a curtain of hanging bones crouches a massive goblin — the Chief. He wears a crown of finger bones and grins, revealing three gold teeth.

choices.label: Offer him gold to pass (costs 25 gold)

nodes.label: Chief's Chamber
nodes.description: You toss coins at his feet. He grunts and jerks his thumb toward the far door.

nodes.label: Chief's Chamber
nodes.description: The Chief bellows and charges!

nodes.label: Chief's Chamber
nodes.description: The Chief crashes down. A Rusty Key drops from his belt.

nodes.label: Old Armory
nodes.description: In a locked cabinet — opened with the rusty key — you find a Leather Vest and a Health Potion. A trapdoor leads downward. A passage also connects to the chapel wing.

choices.label: Take the trapdoor to the lower dungeon

nodes.label: Shadow Passage
nodes.description: The green glow intensifies. Strange symbols pulse on the walls. You hear chanting. Two skeletal warriors stand guard at an iron gate.

nodes.label: Shadow Passage
nodes.description: The symbols form a crude map. A hidden panel slides open revealing a Mana Potion and the Staff of Embers, crackling with orange heat.

choices.label: Fight the skeletons and enter the chapel

nodes.label: Shadow Passage
nodes.description: The skeletons rattle to life, raising rusted blades!

nodes.label: Dark Chapel
nodes.description: Inside, candles burn in purple flame around a stone altar. A robed cultist rises — his eyes are solid black. 'You should not be here,' he whispers.

choices.label: Grab the Ancient Tome and run

nodes.label: Dark Chapel
nodes.description: He points to a gauntlet of fire traps. 'Survive that, and I will open the way.'

nodes.label: Dark Chapel
nodes.description: You snatch the tome and sprint for the door. A bolt of dark energy catches you for 15 damage. The tome pulses warmly in your hands.

nodes.label: Dark Chapel
nodes.description: Dark energy crackles around his hands!

nodes.label: Dark Chapel
nodes.description: The cultist crumples. The candles extinguish. On the altar: the Ancient Tome. A door behind the altar swings open, revealing stairs descending into darkness.

choices.label: Descend the stairs into the depths
Head back to the goblin wing

nodes.label: Fire Gauntlet
nodes.description: You sprint through jets of flame — one catches your leg for 20 damage. You make it through. The cultist opens the passage without a word.

nodes.label: Lower Dungeon
nodes.description: The air changes — heavier, older. Three paths: a door marked with runes, a collapsed tunnel partially cleared by someone recently, and a vast hall radiating heat like an oven.

nodes.label: Rune Chamber
nodes.description: The runes glow as you approach: 'I have cities but no houses, mountains but no trees, water but no fish. What am I?' The Ancient Tome has the answer in its margin.

choices.label: Consult the Ancient Tome and answer

nodes.label: Rune Chamber
nodes.description: You guess 'A Map' — a flash of blue light and the door grinds open. Lucky. Or clever.

nodes.label: Rune Chamber
nodes.description: You throw yourself at the door. The runes flare and blast you back for 25 damage. The door stays sealed.

nodes.label: Rune Chamber
nodes.description: The runes fade. Inside: a perfectly preserved treasury. A Stone Golem stirs — its guardian duty awakened.

nodes.label: Rune Chamber
nodes.description: The golem's eyes glow red as it lumbers forward!

nodes.label: Rune Chamber
nodes.description: The golem shatters. Behind it: a chest with gold, a Shadow Dagger, and a Health Potion.

nodes.label: Hidden Vault
nodes.description: A skeleton clutches a satchel: two Health Potions and 30 gold. A note reads: 'DON'T WAKE IT. Leave the gold. RUN.'

nodes.label: The Dragon's Hall
nodes.description: Massive iron doors hang bent from their hinges. At the center of a cathedral of stone, coiled atop a mountain of gold and bones, sleeps the Elder Dragon. Its scales are midnight black. Each breath sends scorched air washing over you. This is the end.

choices.label: Strike while it sleeps! (bonus first hit)
Wake it and demand it yield
Flood the hall to weaken its fire

nodes.label: The Dragon's Hall
nodes.description: You strike hard before its eyes open — 30 bonus damage lands true. Now it's truly furious.

nodes.label: The Dragon's Hall
nodes.description: 'Yield?' it rumbles, amused. 'Courage alone will not save you.' Fire builds in its throat.

nodes.label: The Dragon's Hall
nodes.description: You crank an ancient water mechanism. The hall floods — the dragon's fire sputters. It lunges in fury!

nodes.label: The Dragon's Hall
nodes.description: The Elder Dragon is upon you!

nodes.label: The Dragon's Hall
nodes.description: The Elder Dragon crashes down, shaking the mountain. Silence falls — broken only by settling coins and trickling water. Light pours through cracks in the ceiling as if the dungeon itself exhales. You have conquered the Dungeon of Echoes. Few ever will again.

nodes.label: The Dungeon
nodes.description: Darkness closes in. The dungeon has claimed you, as it has countless others before. Your name joins the long list of those who dared and fell. The torches flicker out, one by one.
